structured_requirements.title: Candidate registration
structured_requirements.description: Candidates must be able to register with email and password and verify ownership via an email confirmation link.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: New candidate completes registration in under 90 seconds; verification email sent within 30 seconds.

structured_requirements.title: Resume upload
structured_requirements.description: Candidates can upload a resume document (PDF, DOCX) up to 10MB during application submission.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: Upload completes within 5 seconds for files up to 10MB on a 10Mbps connection.

structured_requirements.title: Recruiter dashboard responsiveness
structured_requirements.description: Recruiters can view all submitted applications for their open roles. Dashboard must load within p95 < 2 seconds for up to 500 applications.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: p95 response time < 2s with 500 concurrent applications loaded.

structured_requirements.title: System availability
structured_requirements.description: The platform must maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours (6am-midnight local time).
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: Monthly uptime >= 99.9% measured at the load balancer.

structured_requirements.title: User authentication security
structured_requirements.description: All user-facing endpoints must require authentication via OAuth 2.0. Tokens must expire within 15 minutes. The system must comply with SOC2 Type II requirements.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: No unauthenticated access possible; token expiry enforced; SOC2 audit passing.

structured_requirements.title: AI matching pipeline throughput
structured_requirements.description: The AI matching pipeline must process at least 1000 candidate-role match requests per minute during peak hours.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: Sustained throughput of 1000 req/min with p99 latency < 5s.

structured_requirements.title: Data encryption at rest
structured_requirements.description: All personal data (PII) must be encrypted at rest using AES-256. Encryption keys must be rotated every 90 days.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: All storage volumes encrypted; key rotation automated and verified quarterly.

structured_requirements.title: Observability and monitoring
structured_requirements.description: All services must emit structured logs, expose health endpoints, and report metrics to a central dashboard. Alerts must fire within 60 seconds of SLO breach.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: All services have /health endpoint; alerts fire within 60s; dashboard shows real-time metrics.
